content: In 2 Timothy, Paul says all Scripture is what?
explanation: It comes from God. “All Scripture is God-breathed” (2 Timothy 3:16, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, what is God-breathed Scripture useful for?
explanation: And training in righteousness. “and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness” (2 Timothy 3:16, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, since when had Timothy known the Holy Scriptures?
explanation: His family taught him. “From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures” (2 Timothy 3:15, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, the Scriptures make you wise for what?
explanation: Through faith in Christ Jesus. “which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.” (2 Timothy 3:15, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, Scripture equips the man of God for every what?
explanation: He becomes complete. “so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.” (2 Timothy 3:17, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, what does Paul tell Timothy to continue in?
explanation: He knew who taught him. “But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed” (2 Timothy 3:14, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, right after describing God-breathed Scripture, what does Paul charge Timothy to preach?
explanation: In season and out of season. “Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season” (2 Timothy 4:2, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, God has not given us a spirit of what?
explanation: He gives power, love, and self-control. “For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.” (2 Timothy 1:7, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, near the end of his life, what did Paul say he had kept?
explanation: He finished the race. “I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.” (2 Timothy 4:7, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, in whom did Timothy's sincere faith first dwell?
explanation: Then in his mother Eunice. “which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice” (2 Timothy 1:5, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, Paul tells Timothy to suffer like a good what?
explanation: A soldier of Christ Jesus. “Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.” (2 Timothy 2:3, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, a workman approved by God accurately handles what?
explanation: He has no need to be ashamed. “an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.” (2 Timothy 2:15, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, what crown did Paul say was laid up for him?
explanation: The Lord will award it. “From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness” (2 Timothy 4:8, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, what will come in the last days?
explanation: People will love themselves and money. “In the last days terrible times will come.” (2 Timothy 3:1, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, what was the name of Timothy's mother?
explanation: Her faith lived in Timothy. “and your mother Eunice” (2 Timothy 1:5, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, who was the only one still with Paul?
explanation: Paul asked for Mark too. “Only Luke is with me.” (2 Timothy 4:11, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, whom did Paul ask Timothy to bring because he was useful?
explanation: Useful in the ministry. “Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.” (2 Timothy 4:11, BSB)

content: In 2 Timothy, where had Paul left his cloak with Carpus?
explanation: He also wanted his scrolls. “bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.” (2 Timothy 4:13, BSB)
